component.name: Soplos Repo Selector
component.summary: Advanced APT repository manager for Soplos Linux

description.p: Soplos Repo Selector manages APT software repositories for Soplos Linux: enable or disable repositories, modernize legacy .list files to DEB822 .sources, find the fastest mirrors with a real speed test, and manage GPG signing keys.

screenshot.caption: Repositories list, with repos enabled or disabled per source
Sources Generator: choosing distribution, components and mirror
Sources Generator: live mirror speed test
GPG Keys: imported Debian and third-party signing keys

description.p: Unused GPG key detection and an updated sidebar icon.

ul.li: GPG Keys now flags keys no repository references anymore and that don't belong to any installed package

description.p: Full architecture rewrite of Soplos Repo Selector, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend.
